errors.evidence: The chart does not specify units for the y-axis values. The machine description incorrectly states that the values are in percent. The reference description correctly notes the absence of any units.

errors.evidence: The description incorrectly characterizes the trend after the 2012 peak as a gradual and continuous decrease. In fact, the value increased between 2015 (43.7) and 2016 (45.6), and again between 2018 (33.7) and 2019 (34.1). This simplification misrepresents the volatility in the data.

The description fails to mention that the line connecting the data points is dashed, which is a noticeable stylistic feature. The reference description correctly identifies the line as 'пунктирана' (dashed).
